reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis merely restates the well-known conventional mechanism without explaining why it would differ in a high-entropy alloy, and the proposed 500°C/100h treatment on FeCoCrNiMn is unlikely to produce the brittle precipitates needed to test the mechanism.
reasons.testability: The test design is circular: the falsification condition requires the treatment to fail to produce segregation/precipitation, which would not test the hypothesis but rather the efficacy of the treatment itself.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis does not advance understanding beyond conventional alloy expectations, fails to specify a controlled comparison that distinguishes HEA behavior, and provides no mechanistic insight into why brittleness might or might not emerge in a complex concentrated solid solution.
